Poggianti, Alessia Moretti, Benedetta Vulcani, Yara L. Jaffé, Rosita Paladino, Ancla Müller, Jacopo Fritz, Ana C. C. Lourenço, Marco Gullieuszik. arxiv-2106-09427.title: The design of a new fiber optic sensor for measuring linear velocity with pico meter/second sensitivity based on Weak-value amplification
arxiv-2106-09427.creator: Jing-Hui Huang, Xue-Ying Duan, Guang-Jun Wang, Xiang-Yun Hu
arxiv-2106-09427.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jing-Hui Huang, Xue-Ying Duan, Guang-Jun Wang, Xiang-Yun Hu. We put forward a new fiber optic sensor for measuring linear velocity with picometer/second sensitivity with Weak-value amplification based on generalized Sagnac effect [Phys. 93 , 143901(2004)].The generalized Sagnac effect was first introduced by Yao et al, which included the Sagnac effect of rotation as a special case and suggested a new fiber optic sensor for measuring linear motion with nanoscale sensitivity.

arxiv-2107-12053.title: A Frequency-based Parent Selection for Reducing the Effect of Evaluation Time Bias in Asynchronous Parallel Multi-objective Evolutionary Algorithms
arxiv-2107-12053.creator: Tomohiro Harada
arxiv-2107-12053.description: Abstract Parallel evolutionary algorithms (PEAs) have been studied for reducing the execution time of evolutionary algorithms by utilizing parallel computing. An asynchronous PEA (APEA) is a scheme of PEAs that increases computational efficiency by generating a new solution immediately after a solution evaluation completes without the idling time of computing nodes.

arxiv-2405-01630.title: Investigating the Cosmological Rate of Compact Object Mergers from Isolated Massive Binary Stars
arxiv-2405-01630.creator: Adam P. Boesky, Floor S. Broekgaarden, Edo Berger
arxiv-2405-01630.description: Abstract Gravitational wave detectors are observing compact object mergers from increasingly far distances, revealing the redshift evolution of the binary black hole (BBH)—and soon the black hole-neutron star (BHNS) and binary neutron star (BNS)—merger rate. To help interpret these observations, we investigate the expected redshift evolution of the compact object merger rate from the isolated binary evolution channel.

arxiv-2504-08905.title: Forecasting Conversation Derailments Through Generation
arxiv-2504-08905.creator: Yunfan Zhang, Kathleen McKeown, Smaranda Muresan
arxiv-2504-08905.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yunfan Zhang, Kathleen McKeown, Smaranda Muresan. Forecasting conversation derailment can be useful in real-world settings such as online content moderation, conflict resolution, and business negotiations. However, despite language models’ success at identifying offensive speech present in conversations, they struggle to forecast future conversation derailments. In contrast to prior work that predicts conversation outcomes solely based on the past conversation history, our approach samples multiple future conversation trajectories conditioned on existing conversation history using a fine-tuned LLM.

arxiv-2505-20779.title: CHIMERA : A Knowledge Base of Scientific Idea Recombinations for Research Analysis and Ideation
arxiv-2505-20779.creator: Noy Sternlicht, Tom Hope
arxiv-2505-20779.description: Abstract A hallmark of human innovation is recombination —the creation of novel ideas by integrating elements from existing concepts and mechanisms. In this work, we introduce CHIMERA , the first large-scale Knowledge Base (KB) of recombination examples automatically mined from the scientific literature.

arxiv-2510-24034.title: AutoPrompt: Automated Red-Teaming of Text-to-Image Models via LLM-Driven Adversarial Prompts
arxiv-2510-24034.creator: Yufan Liu, Wanqian Zhang, Huashan Chen, Lin Wang, Xiaojun Jia, Zheng Lin, Weiping Wang
arxiv-2510-24034.description: Abstract Despite rapid advancements in text-to-image (T2I) models, their safety mechanisms are vulnerable to adversarial prompts, which maliciously generate unsafe images. Current red-teaming methods for proactively assessing such vulnerabilities usually require white-box access to T2I models, and rely on inefficient per-prompt optimization, as well as inevitably generate semantically meaningless prompts easily blocked by filters.
